name: Jailer
overview: The account of the jailer of Philippi in Acts 16 reveals a powerful moment of conversion through the witness of Paul and Silas. When the jailer awakens to find the prison doors open, he is overcome with fear and prepares to take his own life, but Paul reassures him that all the prisoners remain. Trembling, the jailer seeks salvation, asking what he must do to be saved. The apostles respond by directing him to believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, promising salvation for him and his household, and then share the Word of the Lord with them. This narrative highlights the transformative power of the gospel to bring salvation and hope even in the darkest circumstances.
